messages:
pagerbot: PAGERDUTY ALERT: P1 - Sagebridge (sage-tenant) - 401s seen from Dedicated GPU pool (vpc-dp-us-west). Please respond. Incident channel created.

alice_oncall: I’m on it. seeing spike in 401s in our logs hitting token validation path. started triage, adding people.

eli_sagebridge_sre: yup customer reported a bunch of failed inference requests around 12:03 UTC. They see 401: invalid_token in app logs. Impacting ~30% of requests to /v1/generate for that tenant.

sam_platform: throwing a quick curl against auth endpoint to confirm:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://vpc-edge.sagebridge.internal/v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="kid not found"
```

sam_platform: `kid not found` points to JWKS mismatch — likely the IdP rotated keys and our JWKS cache didn't pick it up.

carol_sre: which component validates tokens in Dedicated? is it edge proxy or pool runtime?

alice_oncall: edge proxy does preliminary validation (issuer + kid lookup), runtime re-checks. logs show failures at proxy: `jwt::verify_failed kid_lookup`

bob_security: any recent deploys or config pushes to jwks-fetcher today?

sam_platform: no deploys to fetcher, but we rolled the IdP via customer scheduled rotation at 11:58 UTC (per Eli). The fetcher relies on cache-control and ETag; looks like the IdP set `Cache-Control: max-age=3600` which prevented immediate refresh. Bad timing.

eli_sagebridge_sre: we pushed rotation earlier (11:58). our side expected a hot-reload, but saw intermittent 401s immediately after.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) force JWKS refresh on all edge proxies for sage-tenant; 2) enable fallback to previous key for 5m in token validator; 3) notify customer. Sam can you run the refresh job?

sam_platform: running mass refresh script now: `/opt/infra/bin/jwks_refresh --tenant sage-tenant --force`

pagerbot: deploy-bot: executing job jwks_refresh for tenant=sage-tenant in 12 nodes.

sam_platform: refresh kicked off, logs show 12/12 proxies fetched new JWKS with new key present.

carol_sre: after refresh, %401s dropped from 31% -> 4% over 2 minutes. still seeing tail.

alice_oncall: enabling fallback window on validators (+5m) to accept tokens signed by previous key while we coordinate with IdP. Taking it now.

bob_security: caution: fallback increases risk if attacker has old key compromise, but acceptable for brief maintenance. documented exception.

eli_sagebridge_sre: customer confirms traffic returning to normal for most users; some long-lived tokens still failing. they will rotate short-lived tokens.

sam_platform: rolling restart of failed runtime instances to clear any cached validation state in pools. commands: `kubectl rollout restart ds/edge-proxy -n sage-tenant` and `kubectl rollout restart sts/dedicated-runtime -n sage-tenant`

pagerbot: MONITOR: error-rate for sage-tenant set to 5m alert threshold.

carol_sre: handing off to afternoon on-call @sam_platform — I need to jump to another page. Sam, please take lead for mitigation completion and customer comms.

alice_oncall: handing over too; I’ll be reachable for escalation. Summary so far: IdP rotated keys; JWKS cache respected cache-control and didn’t refresh; forced refresh + validator fallback fixed bulk, restart cleared tail. Customer impact: ~30% of requests failed for ~6 minutes, degraded until mitigation.

sam_platform: acknowledged @carol_sre @alice_oncall. I’ll coordinate final cleanups and confirm no recurring failures. Next steps: 
- confirm IdP cache headers (ask customer to set low max-age or push change)
- add active JWKS polling during tenant rotation events
- add canary that hits token validation after provider rotations
- create runbook for forced refresh steps

eli_sagebridge_sre: I’ll ask our IdP team to set `Cache-Control: no-cache` on rotation events and to POST a webhook to our control plane when rotation completes.

bob_security: please file a follow-up with mitigations and risk assessment. Also schedule a joint test with customer to exercise rotation pipeline.

sam_platform: creating incident ticket INC-3612 and will attach CLI logs and times. I’ll update this thread with timeline and customer impact text for PG/SE comms.

alice_oncall: leaving brief for next on-call: watch for JWKS refresh failures, alert if >1% 401s persist after refresh. escalation: @bob_security -> @eng-runtime.

carol_sre: marking this incident as "mitigated" for now — follow-ups required.

eli_sagebridge_sre: thanks team. we’ll coordinate a non-prod rotation test with you next Tuesday.

sam_platform: final note: short-term fix applied. longer-term: implement proactive JWKS pull on rotation webhook + reduce cache TTL. Adding to backlog and will surface in postmortem.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 -> MITIGATED. All hands clear unless further errors crop up.
